name: Red Lentil Soup with Sweet Potato, Pear, Coconut Milk & Lime
ingredients: 48 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Rinse the lentils in a colander or strainer; set aside to drain.
Peel and small dice onion; transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots; add to the bowl with the onion.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, carrot, celery, and spices to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice sweet potatoes.
Zest lime and then cut into wedges (set wedges aside for serving).
Add lentils, sweet potato, lime zest, broth, and coconut milk to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Peel, quarter, core, and small dice pears; add to the soup. Once the soup comes to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until veggies and lentils are tender, about 15 minutes.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with lime wedges on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
